items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, a couple times down on Rush Street when they came through, yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. He had all the cut-offs and all the lead ins and everything, and he never interfered. You didn’t really hear him, but the band felt him, and that’s the idea. But I don’t know. They tell me all the bass players [have] got their amps, and it got so loud I had to play louder, and blah blah blah... That’s baloney.
Yeah. Of course, Mel, of which I saw the poster there, with Thad Jones and Mel Lewis... Multiple times had you hosted the band there? Or was it...
Yeah, a couple times down on Rush Street when they came through, yeah, yeah.
